statement: Fix A ≥ 1 and c > 0. Let n ≥ 1, and let I ⊂ Z be finite. For k ∈ I, let Ka,b,k : R → C and ma,b,k ∈ {0, 1, 2, . . .} be finite-valued step choices in (a, b), with Ka,b,k = 0 whenever ma,b,k = 0. When ma,b,k ≥ 1, suppose that Ka,b,k is C1 outside a set of at most Ama,b,k points and that, outside that set, |Ka,b,k(z)| + |K′ a,b,k(z)| ≤ Ae−cz2 . (7.4) Assume also that ∫︂ R zℓ Ka,b,k(z) dz = 0 (ℓ = 0, 1, 2), ∑︂ k∈I ma,b,k ≤ An, ma,b,k ≤ A √ n. (7.5) For Ka,b(t) = ∑︂ k∈I Dil2k Ka,b,k(t), and smooth compactly supported G0, G1, G2, one has |ΛK(G0, G1, G2)| ≤ CA,c √ n log(2 + n) 2 ∏︂ v=0 ∥Gv∥3. (7.6)
